final_draft.note: I couldn't find an approved answer or policy section that says whether we run a bug bounty programme, public or private. I also searched for a vulnerability disclosure policy or a way for outside researchers to report issues, and found nothing. The closest approved answers cover weekly vulnerability scanning and its fix times (answer:cf6cd56c-3a80-4b19-a668-fa52e57b8eab) and the annual independent penetration test (answer:cdf2a641-4b78-4719-93dc-61c270c7bfa6). Someone from security (security@harborlight.example) needs to supply and approve an answer about bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure.
